## Specification

### Component: Spinner

Work in progress, duration unknown. Server Component–safe. Inherits `currentColor`.

#### Anatomy
- `<span class="ui-spinner [ui-spinner-<size>]" role="status">` containing `<span class="ui-spinner-ring" aria-hidden>` (or `<span class="ui-spinner-dots" aria-hidden><i/><i/><i/></span>`) and `<span class="sr-only">Loading</span>`.

#### Props
- `variant` `ring` (default) | `dots`; `size` `xs` 12 · `sm` 16 · `md` 20 (default) · `lg` 28 · `xl` 40; `label` string (default "Loading") or `false` (decorative: `aria-hidden`, no role).

#### Visual rules
- Ring: border `max(2px, size × .1)`, track `currentColor` 18%, top segment `currentColor`, `ui-spin .7s linear infinite`.
- Dots: three circles of size × .26, gap size × .16, `ui-spinner-bounce` 1s ease-in-out, delays 0/.14/.28s (translateY -40%, opacity .4 to 1).

#### Accessibility
- `role="status"` with hidden text (a polite live region). Reduced motion: the indicator holds still.

#### Acceptance checks
- Sizes measure as listed; `label={false}` has no role; the colour follows the parent's text colour.

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

export * from './spinner';

### `ui/components/spinner/spinner.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type SpinnerVariant = 'ring' | 'dots';
export type SpinnerSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

export interface SpinnerProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'children'> {
  /** `ring` (default) or `dots`. */
  variant?: SpinnerVariant;
  /** 12 / 16 / 20 / 28 / 40px. Default `md`. */
  size?: SpinnerSize;
  /**
   * Text for screen readers (role="status" + visually hidden text). Default "Loading".
   * Pass `false` when the spinner sits inside something that already says it is busy
   * (a labelled button): it then becomes purely decorative.
   */
  label?: string | false;
}

/**
 * Spinner — work in progress, duration unknown. Inherits `currentColor`.
 * Server Component–safe. For a known amount of work use Progress.
 */
export const Spinner = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, SpinnerProps>(function Spinner(
  { variant = 'ring', size = 'md', label = 'Loading', className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const decorative = label === false;
  return (
    <span
      ref={ref}
      role={decorative ? undefined : 'status'}
      aria-hidden={decorative ? true : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-spinner', size !== 'md' && `ui-spinner-${size}`, className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {variant === 'dots' ? (
        <span className="ui-spinner-dots" aria-hidden="true">
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className="ui-spinner-ring" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      {!decorative && <span className="sr-only">{label}</span>}
    </span>
  );
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/spinner.css`

```css
/* Spinner -----------------------------------------------------------------
   <span class="ui-spinner" role="status">
     <span class="ui-spinner-ring" aria-hidden="true"></span>      (or .ui-spinner-dots > i x3)
     <span class="sr-only">Loading</span>
   </span>
   Sizes: -xs -sm (md default) -lg -xl.  Colour: currentColor.
   Reduced motion: the ring stays still (a 3/4 arc); the label carries the meaning.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-spinner {
    --ui-spinner-size: 1.25rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-spinner-size);
    height: var(--ui-spinner-size);
    color: inherit;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
  .ui-spinner-xs { --ui-spinner-size: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-spinner-sm { --ui-spinner-size: 1rem; }
  .ui-spinner-lg { --ui-spinner-size: 1.75rem; }
  .ui-spinner-xl { --ui-spinner-size: 2.5rem; }

  .ui-spinner-ring {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border: max(2px, calc(var(--ui-spinner-size) * 0.1)) solid color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 18%, transparent);
    border-top-color: currentColor;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    animation: ui-spin 0.7s linear infinite;
  }

  .ui-spinner-dots {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: calc(var(--ui-spinner-size) * 0.16);
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .ui-spinner-dots > i {
    width: calc(var(--ui-spinner-size) * 0.26);
    height: calc(var(--ui-spinner-size) * 0.26);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: currentColor;
    animation: ui-spinner-bounce 1s var(--ui-ease-in-out) infinite;
  }
  .ui-spinner-dots > i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.14s; }
  .ui-spinner-dots > i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.28s; }
}

@keyframes ui-spinner-bounce {
  0%, 70%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
  35% { transform: translateY(-40%); opacity: 1; }
}
```

## Usage

**Spinner variants and sizes** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/spinner/variants.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Spinner } from '@/ui/components/spinner';

export default function SpinnerVariants() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
        {(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((size) => (
          <Spinner key={size} size={size} label={`Loading, ${size}`} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
        {(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((size) => (
          <Spinner key={size} variant="dots" size={size} label={`Loading dots, ${size}`} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
